note: The search oracle: queries a person typed, and what the first hits must be. tools/src/gates/check-search-oracle.ts runs every case through the search box's ranking and through kb.mjs find, so both must answer. A case is `q` plus one or more of `top` (the first hit is one of these ids), `kind` or `band` with `n` (each of the first n hits, 3 when absent, is of that kind or band), `within` (id → the rank it must be at or above) and `covers` ({ids, n, min}: at least min of the ids are among the first n hits, for a problem several pages answer together, such as a case study's problem in a person's words with no page name in it). `via: "cli"` holds a case to kb.mjs find alone, for a long description the facts-only search box is not expected to answer. Set `min` to what the ranking reaches and `n` so the last hit it needs sits two places inside it, so an unrelated edit does not turn the case red; never lower `min` to land a change. A missed query is recorded here first: add the case, see the gate go red, then fix the ranking or add a synonym through the kb-vocab skill; run make gate G=check-search-oracle after an edit. The rates over every page's own symptom text are the relevance fixtures' (tools/src/lib/search-relevance.test.ts, tools/src/kb/relevance.test.ts); this file holds the named queries.
